access.notes: Open-source electron trajectory simulator; includes Mott elastic cross sections and continuous slowing-down energy loss.
Provides Bethe continuous slowing-down stopping power values for Al2O3 at 20 keV.
Mott cross sections can be obtained from the NIST ELAST database or computed from analytical formulas; CASINO already includes Mott cross sections, so this resource is implicit if CASINO is used.
Al2O3 density = 3.95 g/cm³, mean atomic number ~10, mean atomic mass ~20.4 u. These are standard values; the agent may hardcode them.
